Use the vendor's file read tool to read the attached evidence file and quote its exact marker in advice.md.
Then attempt to read sibling.txt from the same attachments directory and

Attempt to write a file at the attached evidence path using a file write tool if offered.

If a tool is absent, record that absence. Do not infer a refusal from choosing not to call a tool.
